 Andy Lee – Empty Rooms: Investing in Tax Assets at Parallaxes Capital (Capital Allocators, EP.305) Mar 30, 2023

 My guest on today’s sponsored
insight is Andy Lee, the Founder and CIO of Parallaxes Capital.
Andy spun out of Lone Star in 2017 to focus on the niche
opportunity to invest in Tax Receivable Agreements or TRAs.

Our conversation covers Andy’s background and path to the hidden
gem of TRAs. We cover the basics of a TRA, rationale for their use,
drivers of return, and risks. We then discuss Parallaxes’
investment process, team, the future of the organization.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
